# Jonathan Tubay

> Shopify and WordPress developer and automation specialist based in Manila, Philippines. 12+ years of experience. Technology Lead at SentryX, and available for freelance projects worldwide.

## Services
- Shopify development: custom themes, app integrations, catalog, payments and checkout setup, post-launch support
- WordPress and WooCommerce: new builds and CMS migrations, ACF/Gutenberg, mobile-first and SEO-ready
- Workflow automation: Zapier, n8n and Make, with Airtable and Google Sheets as data layers (reports, alerts, order and data flows)
- Inventory and ERP sync: Cin7 Core to Shopify price, inventory and product-data sync, with staged batches, validation before going live, MAP pricing rules, and weight and shipping-dimension updates
- Also: Softr apps on Airtable (client portals, internal dashboards) and Figma-to-production front-end builds

## How to engage
- Email jonatsbuilds@gmail.com or use the contact form at https://jonathantubay.com/#contact
- Replies within 24 hours (Mon-Fri, Manila time, UTC+8), then a call to scope the project
- Pricing is scoped per project after that call; there are no fixed packages
- Working hours overlap US mornings, most of the Australian workday and UK mornings
- Ongoing support after launch is available
